notes: Produced a complete robot package with the proposed geometry and adjusted controller gains: reduced base_speed to 0.9, ki to 1.0, and increased kd to 1.5 to improve stability and reduce line loss. This is based on the previous race data showing off-track failures and line loss despite the narrowed sensor spread and increased integral gain.
rationale: The latest race data shows that narrowing the sensor spread to ±0.035 m and keeping the sensor size at 0.016 m has not improved performance as expected; the robot still fails off-track on both the oval and s-bend tracks with one line loss event each. The integral gain ki at 1.2 and base speed at 1.0 have not sufficiently reduced overshoot or line loss. The controller compensates for the narrow sensor spread with relatively high sensor weights and integral gain, but the robot still struggles with stability and line detection consistency, especially on the s-bend track where progress is low. To improve, I will keep the geometry stable with the proposed sensor positions and size, but adjust the controller by slightly reducing ki to 1.0 to avoid integral windup and increase kd to 1.5 to better damp oscillations. I will also reduce base_speed further to 0.9 to improve control stability and reduce off-track risk. Sensor weights remain symmetric and scaled to the sensor positions to maintain balanced steering signals. Observation requests remain unchanged to monitor key metrics.
